luminanova.video.title: Lumina Nova — Video Settings
luminanova.options.ultra.tooltip: Preview only in this alpha. Saves your preference, but makes no engine, chunk or shadow changes and provides no FPS boost. Planned for a future release; performance remains to be measured.
luminanova.options.ultra.pending: Preview only — no effect on FPS
modmenu.summaryTranslation.luminanova: Experimental performance research and video settings.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.luminanov: Minecraft 26.3 client mod. General video settings, experimental boolean frustum optimization and an Ultra Optimization preview preference. No FPS improvement or superiority over Sodium has been validated.
luminanova.quality.texel_interpolation.t: Selects terrain sampler filtering. Nearest keeps pixel edges sharp; Linear preserves Minecraft filtering.
luminanova.quality.fluid_culling.tooltip: Optimized skips fluid top surfaces occluded by the waterlogged block itself. Rendering only.
luminanova.quality.fluid_shaping.tooltip: Alternative levels fluid corners near waterlogged blocks to the highest sample. Physical fluid flow is unchanged.
luminanova.quality.entity_sorting.toolti: Enhanced sorts translucent entity models by the nearest point of their bounding box to the camera. This is independent of Sodium quad sorting.
options.renderClouds.tooltip: Disables clouds or selects their rendering quality.
options.particles.tooltip: Amount of particles displayed by the game.
options.biomeBlendRadius.tooltip: Biome color blending area; changes rebuild chunks.
options.mipmapLevels.tooltip: Terrain atlas mipmap levels; applying reloads textures.
